def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)) or isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite number")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite number")
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check shape consistency
    shapes = [logp_with_result.shape, logp_call_only.shape, logp_no_call.shape]
    if not all(s == shapes[0] for s in shapes):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = shapes[0]

    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted loss: negative weighted log probability
    def weighted_loss(logp):
        return - np.sum(logp * weights[None, :], axis=1)

    L_plus = weighted_loss(logp_with_result)
    L_no_call = weighted_loss(logp_no_call)
    L_call_only = weighted_loss(logp_call_only)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
